title: The link check reads the libraries each release ships
text: On 1.20.4 -> 1.20.5 DataFixerUpper removed DataResult.PartialResult. Resourceful Config names it, was counted as linking, and crashed on both loaders in a real game; about a dozen other top mods per loader name it too. The link check read the libraries each release lists, but it copied every library class the old release had and the new one lacked into the new release, meant for a library the new release no longer lists at all (the loader brings ASM). That also hid every class a library both releases list had removed. A library class now carries over only when the new release lists no jar of that library, and a reference into a library is its own type of break on the scoreboard.
finish: No mod the scoreboard counts as linking on 1.20.4 -> 1.20.5 names a library member 1.20.5 removed (Resourceful Config and the mods naming DataResult.PartialResult stop linking on both loaders); the false links removed are counted over every update and the big updates; no mod that still links crashes in game on a removed library member
wrongIf: a mod still counted as linking on 1.20.5 crashes on a removed library class or member, or a mod naming a library the new release dropped entirely (one the loader brings) stops linking
result: The removed-class hole is closed, and it moves the scoreboard by one. Across every update (cloud-exposure run 44992479483 against main's table): 6,167 -> 6,166 mod ports link, big updates 2,000 -> 1,999, newest game 22 -> 22; the one false link removed is Geckolib on Fabric 1.17.1 -> 1.18 (and the 1.17.1 -> 1.18.1 jump). On 1.20.4 -> 1.20.5 the counts stay 20 NeoForge and 28 Fabric (local before/after and cloud agree): the 50 mod ports naming DataResult.PartialResult were already held back by other breaks, Resourceful Config included (on main it was held only by calls into DFU, which were already checked). Library breaks are now their own types: 'class gone (library)' in 16 mod ports, 'call (library)' in 13 more, 243 mod ports in all carry one; 6 are held by library breaks alone (Resourceful Config 1.20.4 -> 1.20.5 and -> 1.20.6, Carry On and CristelLib 1.19.3 -> 1.19.4, Geckolib 1.17.1 -> 1.18). Game proof on 1.20.4 -> 1.20.5 (cloud-load 44992473347 Fabric, 44993955522 NeoForge): no mod that links fails on a removed library member; the failures are libraries ported along failing on loader API changes, and Euphoria Patcher on NeoForge, which needs Commons Compress that the 1.20.5 client ships and the dedicated server does not (it fails on main too).
